File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
Line or code reference: Lines 3297-3310
Problem: The exit-128 promisor classifier in the pre-review merge-topology gate uses `_merge_classifier_stderr_oneline` which is set from `_merge_stderr_oneline` after it may have been mutated by appending the initial promisor stderr.
Why it fails at runtime: This means the sentinel check `["${_merge_classifier_stderr_oneline}" = "<git merge produced no stderr>"]` can fail even when the retry produced no stderr, causing the hard error path to trigger instead of the intended fail-open warning.
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
Line or code reference: Lines 4625-4647
Problem: Same classifier bug as above — the exit-128 promisor classifier in the late detect-conflicts step uses `_merge_classifier_stderr_oneline` which is set from `_merge_stderr_oneline` after it may have been mutated by appending the initial promisor stderr.
Why it fails at runtime: The retry merge exits 128 with empty stderr, the annotation mutates `_merge_stderr_oneline`, then `_merge_classifier_stderr_oneline` is set from the mutated value. The classifier fails to recognize the "no stderr" sentinel, triggering the hard error path instead of the intended fail-open warning.
